scope.description: Assai plus eight material alternatives for project information control, asset context and engineering change.
inclusionLogic: Direct project CDE and engineering-document alternatives used by owners and EPC organizations.
Asset-information and industrial-data platforms competing for operating-asset context and lifecycle budgets.
An established general-purpose content-management substitute. Geographic labels describe availability/context, not measured market share.
notes: Product positioning is summarized from linked official sources. Comparative implications are analytical judgments, not tested feature rankings.
Current names are used: InConcert formerly HxGN SDx2, and Forma Data Management formerly Autodesk Docs. Historical branding is not a separate player.

Focal Assai is excluded from the count of eight competitors. Specialist/regional relevance is represented by Assai, Meridian and the European-origin industrial-data alternatives; no regional market-leadership claim is made.
Business statistics are omitted for alternatives when reviewed product pages provide no comparable product-specific measure. Empty arrays mean unestablished, not zero.
Vortex figures retain their original company-wide scope and missing measurement period; they cannot be used as comparable current product metrics.
Headquarters describe supplier corporate context, not customer-data location. The Octave headquarters is left unestablished rather than inherited from historical Hexagon ownership.

players.name: Assai
players.description: Focal engineering-information specialist. DMS controls engineering records, Viewport provides cross-system asset context and Enterprise coordinates completion of engineering updates. Included as the comparison anchor, not as its own competitor.

businessStats.scope: Assai company-wide geographic reach as reported by Vortex; not product-specific customers or active subscriptions.

businessStats.period: CAGR window not stated; investment profile accessed 2026-09-06
businessStats.scope: Assai company-wide investor-reported ARR growth; no revenue amount, product split or comparable cohort is provided.

players.name: Oracle Aconex
players.description: Project CDE and contractual collaboration alternative for owners and EPC organizations. Official materials emphasize organization-owned workspaces, controlled information exchange and decision history. Inference: compare commercial collaboration, review and supplier obligations separately from long-lived asset-context needs.

players.name: Bentley ProjectWise
players.description: Infrastructure project-delivery alternative with design application integration, managed engineering workspaces, reference-file relationships and review workflows. Inference: particularly relevant when engineering-authoring integration determines the buying decision; compare receiving-asset handover and cross-system change verification explicitly.

players.name: Accruent Meridian
players.description: Engineering document-management alternative spanning project and operating records, concurrent changes, contractor documentation and links to EAM, ERP and CAD systems. Inference: a close comparison for document control and operating-master continuity, including established European industrial estates.

players.name: AVEVA Asset Information Management
players.description: Asset-information alternative combining data from different sources with validation, search, tag/document associations and visualization on CONNECT. Inference: compare brownfield information access and handover usability alongside integration with an existing AVEVA estate.

players.name: Octave InConcert (formerly HxGN SDx2)
players.hq: Not established from reviewed product sources
players.description: Engineering and operations information SaaS for industrial and infrastructure assets. Octave identifies InConcert as the renamed HxGN SDx2. Inference: a direct comparison for contextualized information and governed asset-lifecycle processes; historical Hexagon branding is not counted as a separate competitor.

players.name: Autodesk Forma Data Management (formerly Autodesk Docs)
players.description: Construction CDE alternative with files, reviews, transmittals, issues and shared project administration. Current official documentation uses Forma Data Management and explains the former Autodesk Docs name. Inference: compare project collaboration and authoring ecosystem fit against operational asset continuity.

players.name: Cognite Data Fusion
players.hq: Norway and United States operations; see company office directory
players.description: Industrial data platform that ingests and contextualizes source data in a knowledge graph and exposes it through workspaces, APIs and SDKs. Inference: competes for asset-context and industrial-data budgets; document issue control and contractual transmittals must be evaluated as distinct requirements.

players.name: Microsoft SharePoint
players.hq: Redmond, Washington, United States (Microsoft corporate scope)
players.description: General collaboration and document-management substitute integrated with Microsoft 365. Inference: an incumbent option where customers can configure project sites and workflows; engineering revision semantics, contractual exchanges and operating-master continuity require explicit evaluation rather than an assumption of equivalence.
